title.narrative: Promoting European Integration and fostering consensus in the Republic of Moldova

description.narrative: Increased positive awareness and understanding on the EU accession topic by the citizens, with a special focus on rural and most polarised key audiences (North, South, Russian speakers) who indicate the high susceptibility to pro-Kremlin disinformation. Within the activities of this objective, events will be held in districts and communities, including with participation of European exponents, content will be prepared and promoted about the projects carried out at the local level with EU support, a civic dialogue format will be established - the European Dialogue Forum, in which the government's dialogue with the opposition, civil society and local authorities will be facilitated in order to reduce division within society. This forum will be continuous and it will be held in most vulnerable area, such as Gagauzia.
